## remote-browser

The web page the Worker serves is redesigned: a compact top bar with the API token, one URL bar with Fetch and Remote browser, a result view with the page text beside a filterable list of links (with a Copy text button), and a live-session toolbar with a countdown and a Close button. It follows light and dark mode and holds up at phone width. The README screenshots are retaken, and a new one shows a fetch result.

To get the new page on a Worker you already deployed, run `/remote-browser deploy <name>` again; it updates in place and can keep the saved token.

## bp and shipyard

Each skill now has a README with a quick start, commands, safety limits, file layout and the install command, plus a short illustrative demo animation (a mock-up, not a recording) shown as a GIF with an MP4 beside it.

## Install

Pick one installation route.

For Codex or a direct global skill installation, one skill at a time:

```bash
npx skills@latest add itamaker/skills --skill=<name>
```

or the whole set:

```bash
npx skills@latest add itamaker/skills
```

For the managed Claude Code plugin:

```text
/plugin marketplace add itamaker/skills
/plugin install itamaker-skills@itamaker
```

Existing plugin users can update their marketplace and installed plugin to version 2.1.2. Direct installs update with `npx skills@latest update`.

## Requirements and limits

`remote-browser` needs a Cloudflare account; the free plan gives 10 browser-minutes a day and 3 concurrent browsers. `bp` needs macOS or Linux and installs nothing; its macOS commands follow standard `open` and `osascript` behaviour but have not been run on a Mac.
